consigna: One sustained spoken production of at least twelve minutes: brief a listener on something you followed over the last weeks — what you predict, how confident you are, and where you'd push back on the common reading. Include one stretch held in irony and one where you drop it. With a person, or recorded alone. Notes are preparation; the delivery is spoken.
requisitos: An opinion framed by exactly how firmly you hold it (week 41)
No more than two hedges in the whole piece, both deliberate (week 42)
One passage that withholds and then resolves (week 43)
A prediction as a scenario tree, with the signal that distinguishes the paths (week 44)
microtareas: *Mon (10 min).* Reread your corrected work from weeks 41 to 45 and note the correction that recurs.
*Wed (5 min).* Write three sentences carrying a graded prediction, a single hedge and an understatement together.
*Fri (10 min).* Record the twelve minutes. Then listen to one minute from the middle: does the control hold there too?
autochequeo: Are all five skills present, or did one crowd out the others?
Did two hedges do the work three would have blurred?
Was the dropped irony recognisable as sincerity?
Did the withheld point land, or did I give it away early?
promptCorreccion: This is a review of five skills at once: confidence-framed opinion, sparing hedging, narrative misdirection, scenario-tree prediction and controlled understatement. (1) For each, say whether it is present and whether it is done well. (2) Say which collapsed. (3) Give me one sentence carrying three of them. Correct nothing outside these five areas. ---
